Evil

Resources on the origin of evil after the original creation, the entrance of sin and death, and the sentence: from dust you came, and to dust you shall return.

The Origin of Evil

This page will address the origin of evil after God’s original very good creation. Evil is not eternal, and it is not part of the original nature of the world as God made it.

The Biblical account teaches that death enters after sin. The grave therefore represents the curse and the judgment declared in Genesis: from dust man was taken, and to dust he shall return.

Use this page to collect articles, Scriptures, arguments, and resources about creation, the fall, sin, death, judgment, and redemption.
